# Forest Heating & Cooling

> Forest Heating & Cooling provides heating and cooling service to homeowners in and around Forest, Lambton County, Ontario. The team handles furnace and AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump service, gas fireplace work, thermostat upgrades, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (519) 786-0148  |  Email: contact@forestheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://forestheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Forest, Thedford, Grand Bend, Arkona, Parkhill, Watford
